requirements.label: Deliverables
requirements.means: One TikTok-native vertical, 45 sec sweet spot. No carousel, no static.

requirements.label: Required Length
requirements.means: Target 45s. Hook in first 2s. CTA in last 5s.

requirements.label: Format
requirements.means: Phone-shot, talking-head primary. No landscape reframe.

requirements.label: Theme
requirements.detail: Real glow, real review, real reaction
requirements.means: Lead with the mirror-test moment. Show texture on lips. Compare against bare-lip B-roll.

requirements.label: Tone
requirements.means: Julz Tier-2 voice on. No 'Hi guys'. Skeptical opener, earned payoff.

requirements.label: Required Messaging
requirements.means: Hit product name + 'hydrating' in body. Avoid 'plumping' (not approved).

requirements.label: Product Mention/Demo
requirements.means: Close-up of applicator. Smack lips. Mirror reaction shot.

requirements.label: Posting Requirements
requirements.means: Schedule for Friday 6pm PT. Caption pre-approved.

requirements.label: Usage Rights
requirements.means: e.l.f. can boost on their handles 90 days. No retainer extension.

requirements.label: Payment & Bonus
requirements.means: Invoice on approval. Optimize hook + thumbnail to earn the $200 tier.

requirements.label: Deadline
requirements.means: Film by May 18. Edit window May 19–20. Buffer 4 days for revisions.

requirements.label: Do-Not-Do
requirements.detail: No competitor mention, no medical claims, no minors
requirements.means: Avoid 'better than [brand]'. No 'cures' or 'heals'. Solo shot.

missingInfo.question: Is the $200 bonus tracked at 14 days post-original-post or post-approval?
Can I show the product at a kitchen counter or must it be a bathroom mirror?
Does whitelisting include Instagram or TikTok only?

meansSummary.goal: Make a 45-sec honest-glow review that reads as a real reaction, not a paid placement. Earn the $200 bonus by hooking saves.
meansSummary.audience: Late-20s women who already own 3 lip glosses and are skeptical of TikTok-ad gloss reviews.
meansSummary.keyFocus: The mirror-test moment. Texture proof. A dry-funny final verdict.
dos: Lead with the skeptical opener ('Another lip oil. Sure.')
Compare bare-lip B-roll → applied B-roll within 5 seconds
End on a definitive verdict (yes or no, no fence)
donts: No 'Hi guys' or generic influencer voice
